alt: 少年抬高下巴，抱著雙臂，輕蔑地背對展示作品的同學。
scene_prompt: At a school art club, an arrogant teenager in casual clothes stands chin raised and arms folded, turning dismissively away from two friendly classmates who offer their handmade projects. His dismissive sideways glance and their hurt expressions clearly show looking down on others; no bullying violence.
